payload.title: Kubernetes Nodes

data_source.query:
TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?server == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?server OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?server)))
| WHERE labels.mode == "idle"
| WHERE metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS idle_rate = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.cpu
| EVAL Busy = 100 * (1 - idle_rate)
| WHERE Busy IS NOT NULL
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.cpu`, Busy
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?server == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?server OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?server)))
| WHERE metrics.node_load1 IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_load5 IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_load15 IS NOT NULL
| STATS load_1m = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_load1)), load_5m = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_load5)), load_15m = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_load15)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, load_1m, load_5m, load_15m
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?server == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?server OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?server)))
| WHERE metrics.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_MemFree_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_memory_MemTotal_bytes_C_lhs_lhs_lhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)), memory_buffers = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes)), memory_cached = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes)), memory_free = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_MemFree_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance
| EVAL memory_used = (((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes_C_lhs_lhs_lhs - memory_free) - memory_buffers) - memory_cached)
| DROP node_memory_MemTotal_bytes_C_lhs_lhs_lhs
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?server == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?server OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?server)))
| WHERE metrics.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_MemFree_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_memory_MemTotal_bytes_instance = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)), node_memory_MemFree_bytes_instance = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_MemFree_bytes)), node_memory_Buffers_bytes_instance = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes)), node_memory_Cached_bytes_instance = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL computed_value = (((((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes_instance - node_memory_MemFree_bytes_instance) - node_memory_Buffers_bytes_instance) - node_memory_Cached_bytes_instance) / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes_instance) * 100)
| STATS computed_value = LAST(computed_value, time_bucket)
| KEEP computed_value

TS metrics-k8s.prometheus-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE (?server == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?server OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?server)))
| WHERE metrics.node_disk_read_bytes_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_written_bytes_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_disk_io_time_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS Read = SUM(RATE(metrics.node_disk_read_bytes_total)), Written = SUM(RATE(metrics.node_disk_written_bytes_total)), `IO time` = SUM(RATE(metrics.node_disk_io_time_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| KEEP time_bucket, Read, Written, `IO time`
| SORT time_bucket ASC

PROMQL index=metrics-k8s.prometheus-default start=?_tstart end=?_tend buckets=50 value=((sum(metrics.node_filesystem_size_bytes{device!="rootfs", instance=~?server}) - sum(metrics.node_filesystem_free_bytes{device!="rootfs", instance=~?server})) / sum(metrics.node_filesystem_size_bytes{device!="rootfs", instance=~?server}))
| STATS value = LAST(value, step)

PROMQL index=metrics-k8s.prometheus-default start=?_tstart end=?_tend buckets=50 value=(rate(metrics.node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance=~?server, device!~"lo"}[5m]))
| GROK _timeseries """(?:\A\{(?:"labels":\{)?|,)"device":"%{DATA:device}\""""
| KEEP step, value, device

PROMQL index=metrics-k8s.prometheus-default start=?_tstart end=?_tend buckets=50 value=(rate(metrics.node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance=~?server, device!~"lo"}[5m]))
| GROK _timeseries """(?:\A\{(?:"labels":\{)?|,)"device":"%{DATA:device}\""""
| KEEP step, value, device

config.title: server
config.esql_query: FROM metrics-k8s.prometheus-default | WHERE `metrics.node_boot_time_seconds` IS NOT NULL AND `labels.instance` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY `labels.instance` | EVAL options = MV_APPEND(".*", `labels.instance`) | MV_EXPAND options | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY options | KEEP options | RENAME options AS `labels.instance` | SORT `labels.instance` ASC | LIMIT 1000
